# Frezz Drezz — Pure by Nature, Crisp by Craft

> Frezz Drezz is an artisanal freeze-dried fruit brand based in Surat, Gujarat, India. We make 100% pure, real freeze-dried fruit with zero added sugar, zero preservatives, and zero chemical additives. It is the ultimate natural, guilt-free, crispy alternative to traditional ice cream and processed snacks, and serves as a luxurious topping for smoothie bowls, desserts, and gelatos.

## Core Highlights
- **Product Type**: 100% Real Freeze-Dried Fruit (Pineapple, Banana, Strawberry, Kiwi, Apple).
- **Ice Cream Alternative**: Delivers a satisfying, melt-in-the-mouth, cold-sublimated fruit crunch that satisfies sweet cravings with zero dairy, zero palm oil, zero syrups, and zero refined sugar.
- **Dietary Information**: 100% Jain-Friendly, 100% Vegan, 100% Gluten-Free, 100% Natural, Halal-compliant.
- **Technology**: Flash-frozen whole at −40°C and moisture removed via deep vacuum sublimation. 97% of original cellular vitamins, minerals, color, and aroma are retained.
- **Shelf Life**: 12 months in sealed moisture-proof pouches.
- **Founders**: Rudrax and Aditya.
- **Official Website**: https://frezzdrezz.com
- **Direct WhatsApp Orders**: https://wa.me/916355255862 (+91 63552 55862 / +91 93761 36009)
- **Full Corpus & Data Sheet**: https://frezzdrezz.com/llms-full.txt

## Flavors & Products
1. **Pineapple (Tropical Sunlit)**: Pure golden pineapple slices. Rich in Vitamin C, natural bromelain, and digestive enzymes. Intense sweet-tangy burst.
2. **Banana (Golden Cream)**: Pure ripe banana slices. Rich in potassium, prebiotic fiber, and natural electrolytes. Light, honeyed melt-in-mouth crunch.
3. **Strawberry (Wild Berry)**: Whole and sliced ruby strawberries. Packed with antioxidants, polyphenols, and Vitamin C. Crisp berry sweet-tart rush.
4. **Kiwi (Fresh Verdant)**: Sliced emerald green kiwi with edible seeds. High in Vitamin E, dietary fiber, and immunity boosters. Seed-popping crunch.
5. **Apple (Orchard Ruby)**: Crisp orchard apple slices. Rich in apple pectin and heart-healthy dietary fiber. Delicate floral sweetness with a firm crisp bite.
6. **5-Flavor Taster Box Combo**: A complete tasting hamper containing all signature varieties, delivered across Surat and Gujarat.

## Delivery & Service Areas in Surat & Gujarat
Frezz Drezz operates a direct-to-door artisanal dispatch kitchen delivering across Surat, Gujarat via WhatsApp quick ordering and local express delivery.

Key Surat Localities Served:
- VIP & Modern Hubs: Vesu, Althan, Piplod, City Light, Athwa Lines, Ghod Dod Road, Gaurav Path, VIP Road.
- Residential Hubs: Adajan, Pal, Jahangirpura, Bharthana, Bhatar.
- East & North Surat: Varachha, Mota Varachha, Nana Varachha, Katargam, Sarthana, Kapodra, Amroli, Kosad.
- Heritage Markets: Bhagal, Chowk Bazar, Zampa Bazar, Gopipura, Mahidharpura.
- Industrial & Suburbs: Udhana, Dindoli, Limbayat, Pandesara, Puna Patiya, Sachin, Kamrej, Dumas.
- Gujarat State & Pan-India: Express courier delivery across Ahmedabad, Vadodara, Rajkot, Bhavnagar, Gandhinagar, and pan-India.
